description: Declared complete five-state projection of one fragment-selection draw in the supplied finite worlds. Unit weights model an equal-choice assumption for native random_state; they are not gameplay tuning. Source eligibility and actual unchanged routing limits are independently checked. No native-world, random-seed, timing, whole-incident, multi-draw, or achievement claim. The identical one-day timer is a schema-only nominal clock; no native timing or sequence conclusion is made. Parenthesized expressions fail the connected evaluator; source_meaningful_settlement and source_neighbor_gate are explicitly derived and checked against unchanged source helpers in each complete world, not unexplained external eligibility overrides. All other gates and owner/controller classification inputs remain explicit. Connected string-equality probes also fail; source_is_wasteland is the source-verified boolean category test in these same worlds. This encoding uses only boolean and numeric comparisons with flat conjunctions.
